授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: ボルハルトショアー現代有機化学第6版下巻21〜２５章（２４章を除く）に沿い、アミンおよびその誘導体、ベンゼンの置換基の反応性、エステルエノラートとクライゼン縮合、ヘテロ環化合物について講義する。また、演習を適宜行う。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
We will study four chapters (21, 22, 23, and 25) in the last part of the book "Organic Chemistry, Structure and Function, Sixth edition" written by Professors K. Peter C. Vollhardt and Neil E. Shore. （Japanese translated version is the text book of this lecture)
In chapter 21, we will see chemistry of amine derivatives as a functional group containing nitrogen.
Chapter 22 is abut the chemistry of benzene substituent. Reactivities of alkylbenzenes, phenols and benzenamines will be discussed.
In chapter 23, we will study the chemistry of ester enolates and the Claisen condensation as the continuation of chapters 17-20. These are reactions of carbonyl groups. We will see the synthetic methods and reactivities of beta-dicarbonyl compounds. We will understand the concept of acyl anion equivalent in the latter part of this chapter.
Chapter 25 is heterocycles. Most physiologically active compounds owe their biological properties to the presence of heteroatoms, mainly in the form of heterocycles.
I lecture mainly and sometimes perform exercises.
